title: Plan and Prepare for Electrical Work
description: Ability to read electrical drawings, identify materials, plan work sequence, and obtain necessary permissions before beginning electrical installation or maintenance work.
performance_criteria: Correctly reads and interprets electrical drawings and diagrams
Identifies correct materials, tools, and equipment required
Plans work sequence to minimise disruption and risk
Obtains necessary permits before starting work

title: Install Electrical Wiring Systems
description: Ability to install cables, conduits, and wiring systems in domestic and light commercial premises following IS standards and local electrical codes.
performance_criteria: Selects correct cable type and size for the load
Routes cables safely through walls and conduits
Terminates cables correctly at switchboards and outlets
Ensures wiring is protected from mechanical damage

title: Install Switches, Sockets, and Fixtures
description: Ability to install switches, socket outlets, fans, lights, and other electrical fixtures safely and correctly.
performance_criteria: Correctly identifies and installs appropriate switch types
Installs socket outlets at correct height and orientation
Installs ceiling fans and light fixtures safely
Tests all fixtures for correct operation after installation

title: Safe Isolation of Electrical Circuits
description: Ability to safely isolate electrical circuits before working on them, following lockout-tagout procedures and verifying safe-to-work conditions.
performance_criteria: Identifies the correct isolation point for the circuit
Operates isolation device correctly and securely
Tests for absence of voltage using appropriate instruments
Applies lockout and warning notices before working

title: Electrical Fault Finding and Diagnosis
description: Ability to systematically identify, locate, and diagnose electrical faults in wiring systems and equipment using appropriate test instruments.
performance_criteria: Uses multimeter or voltage tester correctly and safely
Applies systematic fault-finding process
Identifies open circuits, short circuits, and earth faults
Documents findings and proposed remedial action

title: Install and Maintain Distribution Boards
description: Ability to install, connect, and maintain main distribution boards, sub-distribution boards, MCBs, ELCBs, and associated protective devices.
performance_criteria: Correctly sizes and selects MCBs for circuit protection
Connects incoming supply and outgoing circuits correctly
Installs ELCB/RCD for earth fault protection
Labels all circuits clearly after installation

title: Earthing and Bonding
description: Ability to install and verify earthing systems and protective bonding for electrical installations.
performance_criteria: Installs earth electrode or connects to building earth
Installs earth continuity conductors correctly
Tests earth continuity and resistance
Installs equipotential bonding to metalwork

title: Use of Electrical Test Instruments
description: Ability to select, use, and maintain electrical test instruments safely and correctly for installation testing.
performance_criteria: Selects correct instrument for the measurement task
Operates instruments within their rated range safely
Interprets readings correctly
Maintains instruments in calibrated and safe condition

title: Health, Safety, and Electrical Regulations Compliance
description: Ability to work safely and in compliance with relevant health and safety legislation and electrical regulations.
performance_criteria: Uses correct PPE for electrical work
Identifies and manages electrical hazards
Works in compliance with IE Rules and IS standards
Reports unsafe conditions to appropriate authority

title: Inspect and Test Completed Electrical Installations
description: Ability to carry out inspection and testing of completed electrical installations before energisation.
performance_criteria: Carries out visual inspection of completed installation
Performs continuity tests on protective conductors
Performs insulation resistance tests
Issues test completion record and certificate

title: Plan and Prepare for Plumbing Work
description: Ability to read plumbing drawings and layouts, identify required materials and fittings, and plan the sequence of work for domestic water supply and drainage systems.
performance_criteria: Reads and interprets plumbing drawings and isometric layouts
Identifies correct pipe sizes, fittings, and materials for the job
Plans work sequence to minimise disruption to water supply
Obtains necessary permits for plumbing work where required

title: Install Domestic Water Supply Pipework
description: Ability to install cold and hot water supply pipework in domestic premises, including cutting, bending, joining, and connecting pipes to outlets.
performance_criteria: Cuts pipes to correct length without burring or distortion
Bends and forms pipework to the required shape
Joins pipes using appropriate methods (soldering, compression, push-fit, CPVC cement)
Connects pipework to taps, valves, and appliances correctly

title: Install Drainage and Sanitation Systems
description: Ability to install above-ground drainage, waste, and vent pipework for sinks, toilets, baths, and floor drains in domestic premises.
performance_criteria: Installs drainage pipes with correct falls and gradients
Connects waste fittings to sinks, baths, and basins
Installs P-traps and S-traps correctly to prevent sewer gas entry
Connects to soil stack and vent pipe correctly

title: Install Sanitary Fixtures and Fittings
description: Ability to install WC pans, cisterns, wash basins, baths, showers, and associated fittings in domestic premises.
performance_criteria: Installs WC pan and cistern correctly with proper sealing
Connects wash basin to supply and waste correctly
Installs shower unit and associated fittings
Tests all fixtures for leaks after installation

title: Locate and Repair Plumbing Faults and Leaks
description: Ability to identify, locate, and repair faults in plumbing systems including pipe leaks, blockages, faulty taps, and malfunctioning cisterns.
performance_criteria: Identifies source of leaks through systematic inspection
Clears blockages from waste and drainage pipes
Replaces or repairs faulty tap washers and valves
Repairs or replaces damaged pipe sections

title: Health, Safety, and Plumbing Regulations Compliance
description: Ability to work safely and in compliance with plumbing regulations, preventing water contamination and ensuring safe working practices.
performance_criteria: Uses correct PPE for plumbing work
Prevents cross-connection between potable and non-potable water
Works in compliance with NBC and CPHEEO guidelines
Identifies and manages hazards in confined spaces and trenches

title: Plan and Prepare for Welding Operations
description: Ability to read welding drawings and symbols, identify materials and consumables, set up welding equipment, and prepare workpieces for welding.
performance_criteria: Reads and interprets welding drawings and weld symbols
Identifies correct electrodes, filler wire, and shielding gas for the material
Sets up welding equipment to correct parameters
Prepares joint faces by cleaning, grinding, and bevelling as required

title: Perform Manual Metal Arc (MMA/SMAW) Welding
description: Ability to produce sound welds in various positions using Manual Metal Arc welding on mild steel and low-alloy steel.
performance_criteria: Selects correct electrode type and diameter for the material and thickness
Sets correct current and polarity for the electrode
Produces a sound weld with consistent bead width and profile
Achieves full penetration on butt joints as required

title: Perform Gas Metal Arc (MIG/MAG) Welding
description: Ability to produce sound welds using Gas Metal Arc welding (MIG/MAG) on mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminium.
performance_criteria: Sets up MIG/MAG welding equipment with correct wire and gas
Adjusts voltage, wire feed speed, and gas flow for the material
Produces sound fillet and butt welds with good fusion
Identifies and corrects common MIG welding defects

title: Inspect Welds and Identify Welding Defects
description: Ability to visually inspect completed welds, identify common welding defects, and determine acceptability against applicable standards.
performance_criteria: Carries out systematic visual inspection of completed welds
Identifies defects including porosity, undercut, overlap, and cracking
Assesses welds against acceptance criteria in applicable standards
Records inspection findings and non-conformances

title: Health, Safety, and Welding Regulations Compliance
description: Ability to work safely in welding environments, managing fumes, radiation, fire, and electrical hazards.
performance_criteria: Uses correct PPE including welding helmet, gloves, and protective clothing
Manages ventilation to control welding fumes and gases
Prevents fire hazards from sparks and spatter
Prevents electric shock hazards from welding equipment

title: Plan and Prepare for Masonry and Construction Work
description: Ability to read construction drawings, identify materials, set out work, and plan the sequence of masonry and construction operations.
performance_criteria: Reads and interprets construction drawings and plans
Identifies correct types and quantities of materials
Sets out building lines and levels using instruments
Plans work sequence to optimise material use and avoid disruption

title: Lay Bricks, Blocks, and Masonry Units
description: Ability to construct brick and block walls, piers, and columns to correct line, level, plumb, and bond using appropriate mortars.
performance_criteria: Mixes mortar to correct proportions and consistency
Lays bricks to correct bond pattern and alignment
Checks work for plumb, level, and line throughout construction
Forms openings, reveals, and returns correctly

title: Apply Plastering and Rendering
description: Ability to apply scratch coats, floating coats, and finishing coats of plaster and render to walls, ceilings, and soffits.
performance_criteria: Prepares background surface by cleaning and applying bonding agent
Applies scratch coat to correct thickness and keying
Applies float coat to achieve flat, plumb, and level surface
Applies finish coat to achieve specified texture

title: Health, Safety, and Construction Site Compliance
description: Ability to work safely on construction sites, managing hazards from manual handling, working at height, and construction materials.
performance_criteria: Uses correct PPE for construction work including hard hat, boots, and gloves
Follows safe manual handling procedures for heavy materials
Works safely at height from scaffolding and ladders
Identifies and reports site hazards to supervisor
